cause: The broad automatic export filters removed useful room surfaces. Remeshing caused smaller additional losses; it was not the largest observed regression.
controlled_comparison: Same camera, same corrected transforms, same roof cut in each render. Original source meshes, compact untrimmed meshes and previously delivered meshes compared independently.
floor_display_clipping: Not the main cause in this comparison; most gaps were already present in the exported trimmed geometry.
older_bedroom_workflow: Preserved about 9.08M scanned triangles with inspected local debris removal and separately labelled doorway repair. No global remesh or decimation.
correction: Surface-preserving export now retains all 1,082,185 compact triangles. Broad overlap/height cuts and display floor clipping disabled; optional inferred patch/replacement disabled.
remaining: Original mesh warping, some holes and ghost surfaces remain. Full visual-quality gate remains partial.
